title: Day 742: TikTok Influencer César Gastélum Shot Dead Mid-Livestream Outside Culiacán KFC
detail: Content creator César Gastélum, 25 (TikTok: 'Cesarín,' ~600,000 followers, 22M+ likes), was shot in the head and killed around 8:15 PM on August 4, 2026, while livestreaming from the parking lot of a KFC in the Tres Ríos development, Culiacán. He was filming a 'Rappi delivery' comedy challenge on the Kick platform with two collaborators, dressed as delivery workers, when two men on a white Honda motorcycle approached; one gunman shot him at close range and both fled. The attack was captured live and the footage went viral within hours, drawing national attention including comment from President Claudia Sheinbaum, who linked the killing to the ongoing Chapitos–La Mayiza violence gripping Culiacán. His two companions were unharmed. No arrests have been made; Mexico's federal security cabinet said it is coordinating with the Sinaloa Fiscalía on the investigation. Mexican media noted Gastélum is at least the ninth-to-twelfth social media influencer killed in Culiacán since September 2024, following a documented pattern in which content creators' names have appeared on narco-message hit lists tied to both factions.

media.caption: TikTok influencer César Gastélum shot dead mid-livestream outside a Culiacán KFC, August 4, 2026
